sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 334 x 301 x 57 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dealer listings (Go Knight, Adorama, Thomann) read through a search summary 2026-11-12: one USB 2.0 port, one footswitch jack, an external power supply (not bus powered); eight touch-sensitive motorised 100 mm faders. The footswitch jack and the DC input have no catalogue signal (not ports); the USB port is modelled as usb-audio like the Rodecaster. The sloped profile is an estimate (the dealers give only the outer size). 334 x 301 x 57 mm (dealer, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
